minutes.headline: ZBA continued the 1207 Mass Ave duplex lot-width hearing to Feb 28 pending proof the lot predates zoning and wetlands data.
minutes.summary: The Zoning Board of Appeals heard a special permit application for relief from the lot width through building requirement to build a duplex at 1207 Massachusetts Avenue. Members questioned whether the lot was pre-existing non-conforming (created 1969, before the 1972 bylaw change), and a wetlands issue raised by the Building Commissioner was not advertised or ready to act on. The hearing was continued to February 28 at 7 p.m. for research and wetlands information.

public_comment.topic: Disputed the engineer's letter's claim about her property's lot width and build date; said her lot was built in 1971 and made conforming by common ownership; calculated wetlands from the plan as roughly 23% of the lot.
A remote participant, apparently the applicant's land surveyor, said the two lots were created in 1969 under separate owners and gave deed book and page references.

votes.motion: Continue the hearing to February 28 at 7 p.m.

decisions.decision: Board will ask for proof of the lot's 1969 creation date and confirm when the lot width change took effect.
Hearing to be continued to a date certain, the 28th, because the 14th is full.
Wetlands and lot width relief to be decided together at the next hearing; staff to seek Conservation and Planning input on wetlands area.

what_happened.line: The Zoning Board of Appeals continued the 1207 Massachusetts Avenue duplex hearing to February 28 at 7 p.m.; the vote count was not audible.
Members asked for proof the lot was created in 1969 and for the date the lot width change took effect, to test whether it is pre-existing non-conforming.
A wetlands issue raised by the Building Commissioner was not advertised, so the board said it will decide wetlands and lot width relief together at the next hearing.
An abutter disputed the lot history, and a remote participant, apparently the applicant's surveyor, said the lots were created in 1969 and cited deed references.

why_it_matters: The outcome decides whether a duplex can be built on one Massachusetts Avenue lot, and it turns on a lot width rule and on wetlands, which affect neighbors' property and what the town allows on similar lots.
No decision was made at this meeting, and the abutter and the applicant's side gave conflicting accounts of when the lots were created, so the dates the board gets could settle the matter.
